newsitem.title: UK: LME copper off peaks in evening session, still up.
newsitem.headline: LME copper off peaks in evening session, still up.

text.p: London Metal Exchange copper price failed to maintain further gains in late inter-office activity but it still was higher from the kerb close.
By 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,375/$,2378 against a kerb close of $2,367, a $19 gain from the previous day. It had reached a high of $2,383/$2,387 at 1646 GMT.
Late news that strikers at the world's copper mine in China might continue their action appeared to give the metal a fillip in after-hours business.
But it pulled back slightly on further news that copper shipments from Chile's Escondida mine were unaffacted by the strike.
Traders said copper also drew support from light trade buying and fund short-covering.
